headline: The Studio now feels itself falling asleep
lede: sleepwatch v2 closes the blind spots of the tick-gap witness: dark-wake churn, the live asleep-since stamp, and the one-line fix right next to the symptom.

notes.text: #1392 shipped (PR #1398): a night that dark-wakes every few minutes no longer hides behind landing ticks — pulse carries churn=N, the digest says 'dark wakes are not uptime', and no fake outage window is invented.

The live onset (`asleep=true since=HH:MM`) is guarded against rotated-pmset false alarms; against the verbatim Oct 31 incident it would have named 'asleep since 00:17' eleven hours before the Wake did.
sleepwatchcheck grew to 169 gates incl. the churn-no-gap end-to-end; mutant CHURN_SLEEPS 3->90 reddens 17 of them and restores green. v1 ledgers keep pulsing unchanged.
Digest sentences now close with `keep it awake: sudo pmset -a sleep 0` — keeping the shared Mac awake stays Jon's call, but the fix sits one glance from the symptom.
